blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY – The Department of Tourism in Northern Mindanao (DOT-10) has identified Initao, Misamis Oriental, as a potential new diving destination after underwater exploration reportedly uncovered a rare marine species believed to be uncommon in the Philippines. In an interview Tuesday, Ivy Guantero, DOT-10 promotion head, said the discovery will be revealed at the culmination of the three-day Misamis Oriental Dive Festival, or MisOr Divefest, which is tentatively scheduled to begin on Nov. 12, 2026.
